checks.name: 48_samples_to_odd_columns
checks.detail: 48 tubes -> 48 wells, odd columns only: True

checks.name: step_order
checks.detail: expected per well: beads > isopropanol > sample > remove > ethanol > remove > ethanol > remove > elution > recover

checks.name: fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact
checks.detail: 48 distinct tips for 48 sample transfers; violations: []

items.evidence: Slots 1/2/3/9/4/5/6/10/7/11 match the reference deck, with p1000 left and p300 multi right, and `temp.set_temperature(4)` is set for the elution plate.
The checks show 48 distinct tips for 48 transfers and 48 distinct elution wells. The code maps tube i to plate column 2*(i//8), row i%8, with one fresh p1000 tip per sample.

The checks `binding_volumes_40_250_250`, `mix_5x_after_sample` and `incubation_5min_before_magnet` all passed 48/48. The code adds beads, then isopropanol, then sample, runs `p300.mix(5, CHUNK)`, then `delay(minutes=5)`.
The code runs `mag.engage()` then a 4 min delay before removing 540 µL at 0.5 rate. The `magnet_4min_before_first_removal` and `magnet_engaged_for_all_removals` checks passed.
Two 500 µL ethanol additions are each followed by a 500 µL removal with the magnet engaged. The `two_500ul_ethanol_washes` check passed 48/48.
The code has `ctx.delay(minutes=4)` after the last wash with the magnet still on, then `mag.disengage()` before elution. The `air_dry_4min` check passed.

The elution step is correct (100 µL off-magnet, mixed, 30 s then magnet on, 90 s wait, distinct chilled wells). However, the code recovers 100 µL (`p300.aspirate(ELUTION_VOL...)`) instead of ~80 µL, which risks bead carry-over and aspirating air.

Volumes are split into 180 µL chunks for the p300, and exactly 36 tip columns are used across three racks. Reservoir well volumes are adequate and aspiration/dispense heights and rates are sensible; no operator pause is strictly needed.
The step order follows the paper, including the 30 s delay before the magnet re-engages. The only deviations are a minor bead pre-mix in the reservoir and recovering 100 µL rather than ~80 µL.

judge.summary: The protocol passes all 16 measured checks and follows the paper's order, volumes, timings and 4 C elution plate, with a fresh tip and a distinct well for each of the 48 samples. Its one notable deviation is recovering the full 100 µL of eluate instead of ~80 µL, so elution_recovery gets half credit.
